title: Certified Fair
subtitle: Every share the server rolls, in the open

odds.heading: {{source}} odds
odds.note: These are the exact weights in the economy table the server rolls against. Nothing is rescaled or rounded on the way to you.
odds.broken: This odds table could not be shown. The server still rolls from it.

pity.heading: {{source}} guarantees
pity.intro: Miss a rarity too often in a row and the server forces it on the next open. Each source keeps its own count.
pity.unknown: Your count starts with your next open
pity.broken: Your guarantees could not be shown right now. The server still keeps count.

verify.activeHint: The server committed to this seed before your next roll. Reveal it to check every roll made under it; a fresh seed takes over at once.
verify.nextClientSeedHint: 1 to 64 printable characters, no spaces. Leave it empty to keep yours.
verify.nextClientSeedInvalid: A client seed is 1 to 64 printable characters, no spaces.
verify.rotated: Seed revealed. A fresh one is in play.
verify.rotateFailed: The seed could not be revealed. Nothing changed; try again.
verify.pendingActive: This roll's seed is still in play; reveal and rotate to check it.
verify.revealedEmpty: Nothing revealed yet. Reveal the seed in play to check its rolls.
verify.checkHint: Recomputed on this device with Web Crypto: the SHA-256 of the server seed must equal the commitment, and HMAC-SHA256(server seed, client seed:nonce) is the roll.
verify.idle: Pick a revealed seed, or paste one, then verify.
verify.match: Match: this seed is the one the server committed to, and this is the roll it made.
verify.consistent: The seed hashes to this commitment, but this commitment is not in your revealed seeds, so the server never vouched for it.

mismatch.commitment: This seed does not hash to the commitment, so it is not the seed the server committed to.
mismatch.clientSeed: This client seed differs from the one the server published with this seed.
mismatch.unspent_one: No roll used this nonce: the seed was revealed after {{count}} roll.
mismatch.unspent_other: No roll used this nonce: the seed was revealed after {{count}} rolls.

invalid.serverSeed: A server seed is 64 hex characters (0–9, a–f).
invalid.commitment: A commitment is 64 hex characters (0–9, a–f).
invalid.clientSeed: A client seed is 1 to 64 printable characters, no spaces.
invalid.nonce: A nonce is a whole number, 0 or more.

verify.cryptoUnavailable: This browser could not run Web Crypto, so the roll was not checked. That says nothing about the seed: try again, or open CoinPosh over HTTPS in a current browser.
verify.unavailable: The seed ledger could not be fetched.
